changes.before: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, "THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS."
changes.after: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, "THIS IS YESHUA, THE KING OF THE JUDEANS."
changes.reason: Restore the released Yeshua form and keep the Passion-context Ioudaioi rendering consistent as Judeans.

changes.before: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, "THE KING OF THE JEWS."
changes.after: The superscription of his accusation was written over him, "THE KING OF THE JUDEANS."
changes.reason: Keep the inscription ethnonym aligned with the edition’s established Judeans rendering for Ioudaioi in the Passion context.

changes.before: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: "THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS."
changes.after: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: "THIS IS THE KING OF THE JUDEANS."
changes.reason: Keep the inscription ethnonym aligned with the edition’s established Judeans rendering for Ioudaioi in the Passion context.

changes.before: Pilatus wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, "JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS."
changes.after: Pilatus wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, "YESHUA OF NATZERET, THE KING OF THE JUDEANS."
changes.reason: Restore released Yeshua and Natzeret forms and keep Ioudaioi aligned as Judeans. John 19:20 says the title was written in Hebrew, Latin, and Greek, so the English text does not invent one exclusive Aramaic reconstruction.
